correctness.rationale: Geometric descent uses uniqueness of the Artin--Schreier p-deck subgroup for three distinct simple poles in characteristic p>=5. An isomorphism descends to S3 and scalar Fp*, since h^p-h cannot have a simple pole unless h is constant. Normalizing b/a=u,c/a=v gives s(u,v)=(v,u),t(u,v)=(u^-1,-v/u). Three transposition fixed lines u=v,u=-1,v=-1 share exactly (-1,-1); three-cycle points solve u^3=-1,v=u^-1. Counting orbit sizes 1,2,3,6 gives the four formulas. Scalar action on deck translations determines the stated semidirect groups. Independent direct S3 orbit census for p=5..31 agrees. Applies only to Fp-coefficient representatives, not all k-valued triples.
